Title: Dawn operation and Illusions of the Kindred

Messages.Author: Nikolaj Wendt
Messages.Body:
If i use Dawn Operation on an action that is blocked and then use
Illusions of the Kindred to start another combat the "damage is
agravated" carries on to the other combat and lasts the "whole action",
right??
Same goes for using Psycho at superior.

--
Posted via Mailgate.ORG Server - http://www.Mailgate.ORG

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nikolaj Wendt wrote:
>
> If i use Dawn Operation on an action that is blocked and then use
> Illusions of the Kindred to start another combat the "damage is
> agravated" carries on to the other combat and lasts the "whole action",
> right??

No. Dawn Operation only applies to the "resulting combat", by card text.

> Same goes for using Psycho at superior.

Same answer and for the same reason.
